jobs.title: Volunteer Program Manager
jobs.description:
Are you a natural people leader who knows how to build community, inspire service, and help volunteers feel valued? Valley Humane Society is looking for an experienced and energetic **Volunteer Program Manager** to lead and strengthen a corps of more than 200 volunteers who support our animals, programs, and mission.



This is a people\-first leadership role for someone who enjoys coaching, public speaking, problem\-solving, and hands\-on program management. You will oversee the volunteer experience from recruitment and onboarding through training, recognition, retention, and, when necessary, difficult performance conversations. You will also partner closely with shelter and program teams to ensure volunteer support meets real operational needs.

 **About Valley Humane Society:**



Valley Humane Society is a private, nonprofit animal welfare organization incorporated in 1987 with an excellent reputation for quality care and community support. Envisioning a world in which every animal is loved and every person knows the love of an animal, the organization creates a brighter future for cats and dogs by encouraging and strengthening the bond between people and pets. Valley Humane Society is an equal opportunity employer; the team is guided by the values of Compassion, Companionship, Optimism, Gratitude, Collaboration, and Integrity.



Valley Humane Society is located in beautiful Pleasanton, CA, nestled among rolling hills and close to the Livermore Valley Wine Country. The area boasts year\-round recreation, top\-rated schools, and a vibrant sense of community. Visit valleyhumane.org to learn more.

 **Responsibilities Owned by This Role Include:**


* Leading, coaching, and mentoring a corps of more than 200 volunteers
* Managing recruitment, onboarding, training, recognition, retention, and volunteer communications
* Delivering engaging orientations and ongoing training for groups of all sizes
* Providing constructive feedback and handling conflict or performance concerns with empathy and professionalism
* Partnering with Operations and program leaders to align volunteer scheduling and training with organizational needs
* Representing the volunteer program at community events, speaking engagements, and outreach activities
* Tracking volunteer coverage, retention, satisfaction, attendance, and pipeline health
* Improving volunteer systems, processes, and engagement strategies through data and experimentation

  


**Basic Requirements:**


* 3\+ years of experience in people management, volunteer management, human resources, or a related coaching or leadership role
* Strong public speaking, facilitation, coaching, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to manage sensitive conversations and provide clear, constructive feedback
* Highly organized and comfortable balancing strategy, scheduling, training, events, and hands\-on volunteer support
* Comfort using data and reporting tools; volunteer\-management or CRM database experience is a plus
* Basic knowledge of animal care, handling, and shelter safety standards, or the willingness to learn quickly
* Availability for some weekend, evening, and holiday shifts

  


**Work Schedule:**



Full time with benefits

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, AI-Native
jobs.description:
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
  

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
  

  

We are hiring a Business Operations Manager to run the business of Cloud Operations and SRE, and to work 1:1 with the VP who leads it. One role, two halves that reinforce each other: you own how the org plans, reports and follows through, and you own the executive’s time, attention and follow\-through as a system you design and continuously improve.
  

  

We are looking for someone who already runs their own stack of agents and automations, who treats “a human did this manually” as a bug, and who measures themselves by what moved forward — not by what got scheduled.
  

  

If you have been the person on your team quietly building the workflows everyone else asks to borrow, read on.
  

  

What This Role Actually Is
  

* A business operations owner. You run the planning and reporting spine of the org: goals and OKRs, the roadmap, the cross\-functional programs, and the metrics that say whether Cloud Operations and SRE are healthy. You know the numbers before anyone asks for them, and you chase down the ones that do not make sense.
* A program driver. For initiatives that cross teams, you own the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the uncomfortable status update. Nobody should have to ask “what happened with that?”
* An operator. You will run the operating cadence: staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, offsites. You will run these end to end: agenda, pre\-reads, decisions captured, owners assigned, follow\-ups driven to closure.
* A force multiplier to the executive, not a filter. The executive support half of this job is a core part of it, not a legacy attachment. You will own the VP’s calendar, inbox, travel and follow\-through, and you will make decisions on their behalf inside clearly defined boundaries widening those boundaries as trust compounds. You understand what good looks like for implementing an agentic stack to be the filter, and the organizational change management necessary to drive the teams to that filter.
* An org operations partner. Headcount and requisition tracking, hiring loops, onboarding that does not depend on tribal knowledge, team communications, and offsites you own outright.
* An automation builder. Every recurring task you touch is a candidate for an agent. Weekly reports, status roll\-ups, meeting prep briefs, inbox triage and drafting, travel logistics, expense reconciliation, doc hygiene — you build it once, monitor it, and move on to the next thing. Your job is to work yourself out of your own to\-do list, repeatedly. There is plenty more to do after all of this is automated; it is why you are a force multiplier and an operator.
* A judgment layer. Automation is cheap; taste is not. You will know which emails only the executive can answer, which meeting genuinely needs 60 minutes, which “urgent” request can wait until Thursday, and which agent output is subtly wrong and must never go out the door.

  
* 5 or more years in business operations, program management, chief\-of\-staff or senior executive support roles, including direct experience supporting a senior executive, and at least some of it in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity environment (startup, scale\-up, or a team inside a larger company operating like one).
* Genuinely AI\-native. You use AI assistants and agentic tools every day, not occasionally. You can describe — in specifics — a workflow you automated, what broke, and how you fixed it. Prompting is not a party trick to you; it is how you work. Bonus points if you are well beyond prompting and operating with context and graph loop engineering.
* Hands\-on with agentic tooling. Personal AI agents and assistants for calendar, inbox and scheduling; general\-purpose assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) as daily drivers; and connective tissue between systems. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be unafraid of documentation and have a high level of taste.
* The ability to run a cadence and a program. Agendas, pre\-reads, decision logs, status that is honest when it is bad. You are comfortable holding senior people to commitments they made, in writing, in front of their peers.
* Comfort with numbers. You can build a reporting roll\-up, spot the metric that is lying, and explain a trend to leadership without dressing it up.
* Judgment under incomplete information, or with swinging\-door outcomes. You would rather make a reversible decision now than wait for permission.
* Instinctive discretion. You will sit close to board material, compensation, org changes and unannounced strategy. This is table stakes.

  

Nice to have:
  

* You have built something small and useful with low\-code tools — a script, a dashboard, a bot — because it was faster than asking.
* You have run a planning or OKR cycle for a technical org and lived with the result.
* You have been given scope beyond a traditional remit: a project, a budget, a vendor relationship, a team offsite you owned outright.
* Experience in an org where AI adoption was a stated strategy, not a pilot.
* Comfort with data infrastructure, energy, or high\-growth technical businesses.
* You have opinions about which tools are overrated.
* You know how to speak clanker.

jobs.title: Aquatics Operations Coordinator SEIU
jobs.description:
**About the Opportunity**

**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Aquatics Director, the Aquatics Operations Coordinator assists with planning and coordinating pool operations, including **training and supervising lifeguards** , developing and executing staffing schedules, overseeing the facility and equipment operations, implementing policies and procedures, and ensuring the pool is in compliance and operating under best demonstrated practices. This


position will maintain a safe environment that upholds the Trefethen Aquatic Center’s written standards, while ensuring that the facility remains a major part of a vibrant campus, including its facilities, programming, and the safety of all users.


**Weekend, early morning, evening, and holiday work hours will be required.**

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree required with 3\-5 years of related experience and/or training or equivalent
* combination of education and experience.
* Knowledge of best practices in Aquatic Facility management and programming.
* Current Red Cross Lifeguard certification.
* Current Red Cross Lifeguard Instructor certification (or ability to obtain within 60 days).
* Current First Aid for Public Safety Personnel certification (Title 22\).
* Certified Pool Operator/Aquatic Facility Operator (preferred).
* Ability to navigate the American Red Cross SABA platform.
* **Demonstrated strength in ability to communicate, negotiate, and problem\-solving skills necessary to successfully manage issues when resolving conflicts related to direct reports/members/others.**
* Must be able to perform duties of a physical nature, including standing, lifting, sitting, walking, and swimming.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \& ACCOUNTABILITIES**
--------------------------------------------

* **Train and supervise student workers and part\-time temporary staff.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Assist with scheduling the staff using When to Work software, and substitute when needed.
* Weekly timekeeping review, experience with Workday preferred.
* Assess Lifeguard performance through in\-service training and ongoing drills.
* **Ability to identify** **problems, assess alternatives, render consistent and logical decisions.**
* Provide general customer service **and cashiering;** assist with signage, schedules and updating the website.
* Assist with set\-up, management, and coordination of special events (swim team practices and meets, water polo practices and games/tournaments, campus events, etc.).
* Help plan, organize, schedule, and coordinate summer swim lesson programs.
* Teach American Red Cross courses and provide certificates.
* Work with staff to ensure student program support.
* Manage conflicts and effectively negotiate resolutions.
* **Maintain safe work conditions and comply with established safety policies, practices, procedures, and requirements.**
* Establish and maintain an effective customer service orientation toward all campus users.
* Conduct surveys as needed. Evaluate and recommend marketing and advertising venues that align with Northeastern University’s goals.
* **Support the implementation, review, and recommendations related to facility policies and procedures, including facility access, emergency action plans, and standard operating procedures.**
* Assist with social media, pool website, and online marketing.
* Establish and maintain effective and productive working relationships while working in a diverse and multicultural environment.
* Remain abreast of developments in all aspects of aquatics by reading, attending conferences,workshops, trainings, and clinics.
* Ensure the pool is in compliance with all regulatory requirements.
* Assist in the University’s health and safety programs.
* Participate in campus staff meetings and professional training, as appropriate.
* Assume and perform other related duties as assigned

**Position Type**

Athletics
**Additional Information**

Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer.


Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness \& life, retirement\- as well as commuting \& transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information.


All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


**Base Pay Rate:**

$35\.70

jobs.title: Culinary & Quality Assurance Trainer (5231U), Berkeley Dining - #88881
jobs.description:
Culinary \& Quality Assurance Trainer (5231U), Berkeley Dining \- \#88881 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

In the Division of Student Affairs and under the Residential Student Services Programs portfolio, Berkeley Dining is a self\-operated dining program focused on culinary excellence, social responsibility and supporting the living/learning environment of our customers.
  
  

With more than 12,000 meal plan holders, Berkeley Dining serves over 5 million meals per year in 14 facilities with a combination of residential "all you care to eat" dining, retail "a la carte" dining, training table, early childhood education meal production, and catering. Berkeley Dining services the campus seven days per week, seventeen hours per day employing 450 full and part\-time staff and approximately 400 Cal student workers across multiple locations.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

Under the general direction of the Compliance \& Food Safety Officer, the Culinary \& Quality Assurance Trainer is responsible for training the trainer, providing hands\-on training support and collaboration for new hire and existing support across the department to ensure food safety practices, occupational safety, and departmental and University standards are met. Reporting to the Compliance \& Food Safety Officer, this position works closely with the Training Coordinator, Dietitian, Culinary and unit leadership, and other external stakeholders to provide hands\-on training support across all dining units.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

**The First Review Date for this job is:** September 30, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Training \& Development \- 40%
  
  

In collaboration with the Compliance \& Food Safety Officer, Training Coordinator, and unit leadership, develop training materials and provide hands\-on training to senior staff and supervisors in the unit. Provide spot training as needed during walkthroughs.
  
Serve as a subject\-matter expert and provide instruction on knife skills, cooking techniques, station management, just\-in\-time cooking, speed/efficiency, plating standards, and other relevant culinary and food service training needs as identified and communicated by supervisor.
  
Conduct new hire culinary training, including food safety and operational procedures. Work with the Dietitian to ensure allergen training needs are addressed.
  
Facilitate ongoing skill development workshops based on operational standards, seasonal menus, culinary trends, or operational needs.
  
Evaluate staff performance and create individualized training plans to support growth in collaboration with unit and senior leadership.
  
Assess training programs regularly and make changes or improvements, as necessary.
  
In collaboration with the Training Coordinator, Dietitian, and Compliance \& Food Safety Officer, and vendors or other external stakeholders to deliver food safety and other training to all levels of staff.
  
  

Culinary Quality \& Standards \- 35%
  
  

In collaboration with the Compliance \& Food Safety Officer, conduct regular audits of culinary execution, product consistency, and station setup.
  
Ensure adherence to standardized recipes, portioning, and presentation across all dining locations.
  
Promote high standards of cleanliness, sanitation, and food safety in alignment with Berkeley Dinings HACCP plan(s) and local health regulations. Promote occupational safety standards to ensure work safety expectations and best practices are met. Provide spot\-training as needed and make recommendations on additional corrective actions to unit leadership.
  
May support culinary leadership in testing and refining new recipes under a training lens; train the trainer on approved menu items and production methods. Perform spot training to staff, as needed.
  
Investigate non\-compliance and/or potential concerns or issues as identified by the incumbent and/or the Compliance \& Food Safety Officer.
  
Recommend standard policies or protocols to the Compliance \& Food Safety Officer to address concerns.
  
Investigate and address food waste inconsistencies or the food waste gap in collaboration with the Sustainability Manager and Compliance \& Food Safety Officer.
  
  

Operational Support \- 10%
  
  

Collaborate with culinary leadership and unit managers to identify training gaps and operational inefficiencies.
  
Help implement workflow improvements and best practices for high\-volume environments.
  
Serve as a resource for troubleshooting common operational challenges (equipment usage, production timing, menu transitions, etc.).

jobs.title: Program Manager II
jobs.description:
Berkeley, California is a small city with a big reputation. At just ten square miles of land and seven square miles of water, Berkeley is famous around the globe as a center for academic achievement, scientific exploration, free speech, and the arts, and home to over 50 parks, a top\-ranked university, and the largest public marina in the San Francisco Bay.


**JOB OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------


The City of Berkeley invites applications for the Program Manager II position! As a Program Manager II, you will have the opportunity to organize and manage major City programs or projects that have a high degree of visibility and are of substantial impact. Responsibilities include development and implementation of program goals and elements. You may also supervise staff and develop procedures, programs and methodologies.
  

  

The current vacancy is in the Health, Housing, and Community Services (HHCS) Department. However, the eligible list established from this recruitment may be used to fill vacancies in several departments throughout the City.
  

  

In the HHCS Department: The incumbent will lead the strategic planning, operations, and management of at least two units within Berkeley's Housing and Community Services Division. This role involves overseeing affordable housing initiatives, supportive services, and division\-wide special projects aimed at supporting low\-income, homeless, senior, and disabled community members. Operating with minimal supervision, the manager will supervise professional staff and ensure compliance with various federal, state, and local funding sources.
  

  

See the full job specification here: https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/berkeley/classspecs/1422589


**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------


A typical way of gaining the knowledge, skills, and abilities for this classification is:
  

Equivalent to graduation from a four year college or university with major coursework in business or public administration, or a related field and five (5\) years in the development and implementation of programs.
  

  

Other requirements: Must be able to travel to various locations within and outside the City of Berkeley to meet program needs and to fulfill the job responsibilities. When driving on City business, the incumbent is required to maintain a valid California driver's license as well as a satisfactory driving record. Must be able to attend evening and weekend meetings.


**APPLICATION PROCESS**
-----------------------


Applications must be received by 5:00 PM Pacific on September 28, 2026 and must include a completed application and answers to the supplemental questions. Please note that resumes are not a substitute for a completed application.  

  

Applications are available in alternative formats (audio\-format, braille, large print, electronic text, etc.) upon request to ada@berkeleyca.gov. Please allow 10 days for production of the material in an alternative format.
**EXAM PROCESS**
----------------


The exam process will include, but may not be limited to:
* Application review for minimum qualifications and required documents
* Review of Supplemental Questionnaire
* Oral Board Exam
  

Tests may consist of any combination of written, oral or other exercises or assessment procedures that test content and may include, but are not necessarily limited to, typing, math, reading, writing and analytical skills; problem solving ability; computer and software proficiency, or any other job\-related knowledge, skill, ability or qualification. The examination process and dates are subject to change. The City may, without notice, change or eliminate any assessment component as needs dictate. Applicants passing all examination phases will have their names placed on an employment eligible list that hiring departments will use to conduct final selection interviews.  

  

  

Reasonable Accommodations: The City is committed to making reasonable accommodations in the examination process and in the work environment. Individuals requesting reasonable accommodations in the examination process must submit a request in writing to hr@berkeleyca.gov at the time of application.
**PRE\-EMPLOYMENT PROCESS**


Candidates under final consideration for employment with the City will undergo an employment background check that may include, but is not limited to: confirmation of employment history, educational credentials and degrees, certificates, registrations, and licenses including driver's license; credit check; criminal history check; and Live Scan fingerprinting.


**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY (EEO) EMPLOYER**


The City of Berkeley is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. All employment actions shall be administered regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, age, physical or mental disability or medical condition, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, veterans’ status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.


**DISASTER SERVICE WORKER**


All City employees are required to provide services as Disaster Service Workers in the event of an emergency/disaster.

This role serves as the primary owner of regulatory intelligence, state\-level approval tracking, accreditation data support, and operational reporting across all HCOE healthcare programs at Capella University and Strayer University.

jobs.description:
**Overview**


Quality Coding Software Solutions (QCSS) is seeking a Customer Success Support Manager to lead our Support Desk function supporting Managed Care and Community\-Based Healthcare clients. This role is responsible for overseeing the Support team, while ensuring exceptional support experiences for all health plan end users. We offer an exciting opportunity to support health care insurers and providers in improving health care outcomes for vulnerable populations. Our solutions positively impact over two hundred fifty thousand health plan members.


The Customer Success Support Manager serves as the operational owner of the support experience, support processes, SLA performance, and cross\-functional collaboration. This individual will leverage Jira Service Management to oversee ticket operations, identify trends, improve workflows, and ensure customers receive timely and effective support. This role requires a customer\-focused leader who can balance strategic planning with operational execution while working closely with Customer Success, Product, Technology, Implementation, and Executive Leadership teams.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Lead and manage the day\-to\-day support desk operations, ensuring timely, high\-quality support across all client health plans.
* Own support performance, including response times, resolution times, SLA compliance, and overall service quality.
* Serve as the escalation point for the Support team for customer issues and critical incidents.
* Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer and application issues, using strong problem\-solving and technical skills to minimize unnecessary escalations to Product and Engineering.
* Monitor support workload, ticket trends, and operational metrics to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Administer and optimize Jira Service Management for the support function
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs to measure and analyze support performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to resolve customer issues and improve the overall customer experience.

* Proven ability to manage support operations and service delivery metrics.
* Experience building and improving customer support processes.
* Strong problem\-solving, organizational, and analytical skills.
* Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.


**Preferred**


* Experience supporting healthcare organizations, health plans, managed care organizations, or healthcare technology solutions.
* Experience with healthcare SaaS platforms and data\-driven solutions.
* Knowledge of customer success methodologies and customer lifecycle management.
* Experience developing dashboards and reporting using Jira and business intelligence tools.


**Location/Travel**

**Hiring Process**


* The initial screen will be a 30\-minute call

Candidates for this position will be required to undergo a pre\-employment background check. jobs.title: Product Owner / Business Analyst (Remote Opportunity)
jobs.description:
Mind Computing is seeking a fulltime, 100% remote **Product Owner / Business Analyst** to support a project with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The ideal candidate will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and Agile delivery teams, translating business objectives and federal requirements into actionable product direction. This role will focus on product backlog management, user story development, stakeholder collaboration, and Agile delivery, with an emphasis on federal healthcare workflows, EDI transactions, interoperability standards, and SAFe/Agile methodologies while ensuring solutions meet security, accessibility, and compliance requirements.


The candidate must reside within the continental US.


**Responsibilities:**

  

* Establish and maintain a product vision and roadmap aligned with agency mission, strategic objectives, and federal requirements.
* Translate federal healthcare priorities, policies, and modernization initiatives into actionable product and backlog items (e.g., MISSION Act, VA Modernization, Interoperability Rules).
* Ensure product direction aligns with enterprise architecture, data governance, and interoperability standards.
* Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, compliance requirements, stakeholder priorities, and urgency.
* Develop detailed user stories and acceptance criteria reflecting complex federal healthcare workflows, including referrals, scheduling, RFS, and EDI transactions.
* Ensure backlog items meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done requirements, including security and accessibility considerations.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business owners, SMEs, clinical stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate communication across business and technical teams.
* Ensure product features and releases comply with HIPAA, Section 508 accessibility requirements, and agency specific security controls.
* Coordinate with teams supporting related products and systems across the enterprise portfolio.
* Ensure product capabilities support healthcare interoperability standards and workflows, including HL7, FHIR, and EDI 278/275/217 transactions.
* Lead and participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release planning.
* Review completed functionality against acceptance criteria and business requirements prior to release.
* Coordinate with development, testing, security, and change management teams to ensure releases are fully tested, documented, and approved.
* Identify opportunities to improve access to services, reduce administrative burden, and enhance overall service delivery.
* Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 8 years of professional analyst experience.
* Demonstrated experience working as a Product Owner and/or Business Analyst within Agile delivery environments.
* Strong experience with SAFe/Agile methodologies, including backlog management, user story development, refinement, sprint planning, and release planning.
* Demonstrated expertise with EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transactions, including hands on experience analyzing, interpreting, and validating EDI data within complex enterprise workflows.
* Strong understanding of software development and product delivery processes, including requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and validation.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex business challenges and develop effective solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate across multiple stakeholders and delivery teams.

**Additional Qualifications:**


* Experience with SAFe/Agile.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification preferred.
* Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal/government agencies.
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, EDI 278/275/217, and healthcare integration workflows.
* Experience working with HIPAA, Section 508, federal security controls, and government compliance requirements.
* Ability to obtain government clearance.

**Benefits:**


* Medical/Dental/Vision
* PTO \+ Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop
* Training opportunities
* 401(k) with employer match
* Remote work options


**Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.**


Mind Computing is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.


At this time, we are unable to offer sponsorship.
